title: Speak to Razlo

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Are you looking for me? How things change. For the better, in my case. Not sure about yours...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you looking for me? How things change. For the better, in my case. Not sure about yours...

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: The road to corporate domination is paved with bad ties and formulaic manoeuvres. I've chosen a more interesting path.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The road to corporate domination is paved with bad ties and formulaic manoeuvres. I've chosen a more interesting path.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I don't enjoy being patronized. What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't enjoy being patronized. What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: And I have a schedule to keep. What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I have a schedule to keep. What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Oh yes, Mr Nyx-Curzona, thirty-eighth in line to the board. We had the same Attitudinizing tutor. A lot of good it did him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh yes, Mr Nyx-Curzona, thirty-eighth in line to the board. We had the same Attitudinizing tutor. A lot of good it did him.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Posture. Stature. Bearing. Being from the Spire is all about making yourself seen.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Posture. Stature. Bearing. Being from the Spire is all about making yourself seen.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Every credit token has two sides. Once you know how to be seen, you know how to be unseen. I find the latter… more useful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Every credit token has two sides. Once you know how to be seen, you know how to be unseen. I find the latter… more useful.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Oh yes, I was there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh yes, I was there.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I didn’t go to get cartwheeled on bubblesnuff. I went there to watch. To gather... insurance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn’t go to get cartwheeled on bubblesnuff. I went there to watch. To gather... insurance.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I just like taking photos of parties. The precious memories. I make sure to save copies.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just like taking photos of parties. The precious memories. I make sure to save copies.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: You see? Already the information is worth something. And I didn’t even need to wait twenty years.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You see? Already the information is worth something. And I didn’t even need to wait twenty years.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Mr Nyx-Curzona did indeed commit a faux pas. A very serious one. I even have photographic evidence of it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mr Nyx-Curzona did indeed commit a faux pas. A very serious one. I even have photographic evidence of it.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: No. He forgot to turn on his sweat gland inhibitor. He perspired all night!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. He forgot to turn on his sweat gland inhibitor. He perspired all night!

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I see you don’t understand. Perspiration is considered a crime against both poise and fashion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see you don’t understand. Perspiration is considered a crime against both poise and fashion.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Oh, I promise I won’t use the images for a good while yet. Some things are better left to age. Say hello to Eldridge for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I promise I won’t use the images for a good while yet. Some things are better left to age. Say hello to Eldridge for me.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: If Eldridge was photographed with sweat-marked garments… well. He would do a lot to make those images go away.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If Eldridge was photographed with sweat-marked garments… well. He would do a lot to make those images go away.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Right in front of everyone! It came out beautifully on camera. You should have seen his face when I told him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right in front of everyone! It came out beautifully on camera. You should have seen his face when I told him.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: It came out beautifully on camera. You should have seen his face when I told him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It came out beautifully on camera. You should have seen his face when I told him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you don't regret failing those exams?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you don't regret failing those exams?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you don't regret failing those exams?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you don't regret failing those exams?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not here to chat, I just have a question.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not here to chat, I just have a question.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not here to chat, I just have a question.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not here to chat, I just have a question.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you know Eldridge?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know Eldridge?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "Attitudinizing"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Attitudinizing"?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did you see Eldridge at a party recently?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you see Eldridge at a party recently?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Did you see Eldridge at a party recently?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Did you see Eldridge at a party recently?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I wouldn't say that's your forte.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wouldn't say that's your forte.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I wouldn't say that's your forte.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I wouldn't say that's your forte.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So were you unseen at this party Eldridge was at?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So were you unseen at this party Eldridge was at?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So were you unseen at this party Eldridge was at?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So were you unseen at this party Eldridge was at?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Doesn't seem like your scene.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn't seem like your scene.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mean blackmail material?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean blackmail material?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So: Eldridge?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So: Eldridge?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you saw what Eldridge did...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you saw what Eldridge did...?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you saw what Eldridge did...?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you saw what Eldridge did...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He ordered a ham daiquiri?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He ordered a ham daiquiri?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He tried to start a library, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He tried to start a library, right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He tried to start a library, right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He tried to start a library, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He exiled himself for sweating?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He exiled himself for sweating?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Give me the photos.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Give me the photos.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're going to blackmail him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're going to blackmail him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you're going to blackmail him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you're going to blackmail him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Stop gloating and tell me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Stop gloating and tell me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me please?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me please?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How ... GAUCHE!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How ... GAUCHE!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How was it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How was it?
